entities.summary: Jordan Anthony is an American sprinter. He is the reigning World and American champion over 60 metres, having won the titles at the 2026 World Athletics Indoor Championships and 2026 USA Indoor Championships. He previously won the 2025 NCAA Indoor Championships over 60 metres and the 2025 NCAA Outdoor Championships over 100 metres.
